items.check: No test labels used during training
items.evidence: Seed-42 split (train_model_v2.splits): train 72,000, validation 18,000, test 30,000, pairwise index overlap 0. Seeds 42–51 (common.stratified_splits): overlaps {42: 0, 43: 0, 44: 0, 45: 0, 46: 0, 47: 0, 48: 0, 49: 0, 50: 0, 51: 0}. Models are fitted on the training indices only (CalibratedClassifierCV.fit(X_train)). Frozen artefact records test_rows_used_in_any_decision = False.

items.check: No test labels used for threshold selection
items.evidence: Frozen threshold 0.1123 re-derived from validation probabilities only: 0.112265 -> 0.1123. All 130 ablation/multi-seed fits satisfy validation FPR ≤ 1%; 64 of them exceed 1% on test, which would not happen if the test split had been used to tune.

items.check: No test-set metric used for model selection
items.evidence: The V2 configuration (learner, calibration, 47-feature set) was frozen on validation (models/metrics_v2.json: threshold_selected_on = 'validation split', test_rows_used_in_any_decision = False). The ablation and ten-seed runs select nothing: every configuration is reported.

Chronological replay, 3 streams: store max(at) < t before every assessment (180,000 checks, 0 violations); arrival window (142,634, 0), connected component (142,634, 0) and positional-finding gates (142,634, 0) equal an independent shadow of earlier payments.

items.check: No post-payment information used at pre-payment decision time
items.evidence: In the replay loop check_payee(...) precedes record_payment(...) (verified in source: True); an independent rebuild of the store from earlier payments only reproduced the recorded assessment exactly for 165 sampled payments (0 differences). Row-level corpus: each row is generated as the evidence state before the payment (dataset_v2 docstring); no post-payment column exists.

Replay: the payer's profile and velocity are built from that payer's rows appended only after each assessment (prior[payer].append follows record_payment); velocity.prepayment_velocity filters history < t. Pair-count check (test 2) 180,000 checks, 0 violations.
Distinct payers read at t equal the shadow of earlier payments (180,000 checks, 0 violations); payee_history(before=t) applies a strict inequality.

The pipeline has no fitted preprocessing step outside the estimator: HistGradientBoosting bins and its internal early-stopping hold-out are fitted within each training fold of CalibratedClassifierCV.fit(X_train).
No imputer is used: missing values stay NaN and are routed natively by HistGradientBoosting; availability flags record absence.
No scaler is used (tree model on raw feature values).
Isotonic calibration is fitted by 5-fold cross-validation inside the training split (isotonic, 5-fold); validation and test are never passed to fit().

items.check: No message-template leakage between train and test
items.evidence: Caveat disclosed: message texts are drawn from one pool of 1,022 templates, so 99.88–99.99% of test messages reuse a template seen in training rows, and the coercion weights were fitted on that pool. No label crosses splits. The effect was measured with a template-disjoint control (disjoint template halves, coercion model refitted on the training half, 10 seeds): full-V2 PR-AUC 0.7155 ± 0.0219 vs 0.7196 ± 0.0228 (paired Δ -0.42 ± 0.71 pp); social-engineering recall Δ -0.11 ± 1.49 pp.

Index sets are disjoint (item 1). Identical 47-feature vectors across splits (seed 42): train∩test 0, validation∩test 0, train∩validation 0 distinct vectors; 0 test rows have a feature vector that also occurs in train or validation; 0 feature vectors occur with both labels. No feature vector is shared across splits.

No identifier is a feature (columns matching id/user/vpa/txn/name: ['amount_over_user_avg', 'seconds_since_last_txn']). Caveat disclosed: the row-level split is random, so one simulated payer's rows can appear in train and test; generalisation to unseen payers is not measured by the row-level experiments.

No feature is computed from the label or the scenario at assessment time. Strongest single features on the training split (univariate AUC, max(AUC, 1−AUC), non-missing rows): arrival_span_days 0.926, payee_repeat_ratio 0.909, lifespan_days 0.901, payee_age_days 0.890, component_size 0.864 — no single feature separates the classes. The simulator draws features conditional on the scenario by design; that is the generating process, not a leak, and is a stated limitation.

items.check: Current transaction not inserted before its own chronological assessment
items.evidence: Source order check_payee → record_payment (True); store contains no payment at or after t (180,000 checks, 0 violations); a first-time pair is reported as new (180,000 checks, 0 violations).

items.check: No hidden fraud labels used by evidence modules
items.evidence: No file under backend/app references 'is_fraud' or 'scenario' (files matching: none). check_payee signature: (payload: 'str', payer_id: 'Optional[str]' = None, amount: 'Optional[float]' = None, conn: 'Optional[sqlite3.Connection]' = None, intent: 'Optional[str]' = None, message: 'Optional[str]' = None, profile: 'Optional[dict[str, Any]]' = None, history: 'Optional[Any]' = None, timestamp: 'Optional[str]' = None, velocity: 'Optional[dict[str, float]]' = None) -> 'dict[str, Any]'; the replay passes only payload, payer id, amount, stated intent, message, the payer's earlier rows (timestamp, amount, merchant, upi_id, status, txn_type, time_known) and the time — no label field.

items.check: No outcome information used in the pre-payment path
items.evidence: The assessment path is read-only (observation written only by record_payment after confirmation); settlement outcome, complaints and labels are not inputs. Payee reports exist in the schema but no replay payment files a report, so no outcome-derived report enters.
